name: yawr-preview
description: Preview Yawr runbooks (.runbook.yaml) as a structural graph in VS Code.

chatParticipants.name: yawr
chatParticipants.description: Yawr runbook assistant. Use /arm-mcp to arm the MCP bridge with a tool invocation token.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run a runbook in-handler and drive MCP tool calls live. Usage: @yawr /run <runbook.yaml> [key=val ...]

commands.name: arm-mcp
commands.description: Diagnostic only: capture a tool invocation token (causes VS Code to start MCP servers ~60s). Does NOT authorize deferred runs; use /run instead.

yawr.autocomplete.enabled.description: Complete offline tool references, actions, argument keys and core-selected expression functions. Independent of highlighting; YAML services remain active. Required arguments are inserted only by the explicit command.

yawr.highlighting.enabled.description: Highlight tool-declared SQL, KQL and PowerShell and core-selected authored GXL/GIS expressions offline. YAML language services remain active.

yawr.highlighting.developmentHelperPath.description: Development only: absolute path to the shared offline authoring/presentation helper. Each feature verifies its independent capabilities. Empty uses the matching packaged helper, independently of yawr.binaryPath.

yawr.packageMap.markdownDescription: Path used to resolve the package map passed to direct `yawr run` execution. Absolute or relative to the active runbook's project root. When this points to `*.serve-package-map.yaml`, a sibling `*.package-map.yaml` is preferred when present. Leave empty to use the project-root convention (`package-map.yaml`).

yawr.mcpBridge.toolNameOverrides.markdownDescription: Override the registered MCP tool name for a logical `tool/action` key. Use this to correct a name mismatch in a live session without a code change or release. Example: `{ "tsg-recommendation/recommend": "my-org-tsg-recommend" }`

yawr.binaryPath.description: Path to the Yawr CLI binary used for offline previews.

enumDescriptions: Option 3: Modern Bauhaus smooth curves with continuous bezier geometry (default)
Option 1: Linear / Raycast dark minimalist with soft chamfers and side rails
Option 2: Vercel / Temporal workflow canvas with shape-coded header badges
yawr.preview.nodeStyle.description: Visual stereotype style for the React Flow runbook graph preview: smooth-curves (default), minimalist, or header-badges.

yawr.preview.minimumStepDisplayMs.description: Minimum time in milliseconds to display ordinary live current steps in the editor visualization only; runtime execution and persistence are never delayed. 0 disables pacing. Changes apply to the next run or session.

enumDescriptions: Open the React Flow preview in an editor group beside the runbook.
Open the React Flow preview as a tab in the runbook's editor group.
yawr.preview.openLocation.description: Controls where the React Flow runbook preview opens.

scripts.compile: npm run compile:extension && npm run compile:webview && npm run compile:highlighting
scripts.test:authoring:core: npm run compile:extension && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/authoring-production.cjs test/authoring-pairs-production.cjs test/authoring-include-production.cjs
